::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 8th 1888  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 8
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)

I am afraid I never answered about the MS. It will not do being too much of the mere novelette. I do not object to such dénouements, but a story ought, I think to turn on something besides.

[Miss Coleridge](people/person_329.qmd) has £5 a year for her work upon [Debatable Ground](other_books/otherbook_1045.qmd). I do not know if that was mentioned but she has not had it yet. I think you have her new address.

I think you have all the addresses this time except 

[Padre Agostino](other_books/otherbook_1046.qmd)
[Mrs Morgan Morgan](people/person_1055.qmd)
St Peter’s Parsonage Peterhead NB

[Workhouse Infirmary](other_books/otherbook_1047.qmd)
[Miss Cazenove](people/person_274.qmd)
Ravensleigh
Betchworth

[Mother Carey](other_books/otherbook_1048.qmd)
[Miss Bramston](people/person_198.qmd)
41 Dingwall Road 
Croydon

She - as you know is an author <u>with a name</u>

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---
